assumptions.purpose: Discovery scanner: which chart should be opened first, not a buy/sell signal.
assumptions.universe: Canadian-listed instruments from reviewed universe; CAD only by construction.
assumptions.stagePrinciple: Stage describes chart maturity; evidence ranks candidates inside a stage.
assumptions.earlyWatch: Prior weakness near a recent low plus fresh evidence of downside exhaustion/reclaim; no full reversal confirmation required.
assumptions.dedupe: Backtest evaluates first stage episodes and suppresses same-symbol same-stage overlap for each forward horizon.
assumptions.ranking: Stage-specific evidence score is fixed before reading outcomes; train score terciles are applied unchanged to test.
assumptions.validation: 5D/10D/20D, benchmark excess, MAE/MFE, chronological 70/30 holdout, batch stability.
assumptions.surface: Backend-only final shortlist: Review First quality threshold plus a small maximum display count; never fill a quota.
